name: Marian's Eye
source:
Nelle is a university student on her way to reunite with her high school friend, Marian.

While waiting for her arrival, she is suddenly whisked away into a dream world, where a strange creature wields power over her reality.

In a constantly shifting photobook of alternate realities, will Nelle find the Marian she once knew?

[From [url=https://corinna-vndev.itch.io/marians-eye]Itch.io[/url]]
